channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Omer Asik | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Omer Asik from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Alvin Gentry on Omer Asik
item.description:
Gentry on Omer Asik (illness):

“He took a trip to Mexico over (the All-Star) break, and that may be part of it. He's lost a lot of weight. I think he's starting to feel better, but it's just a weird situation that happens. Now we're just trying to get him healthy.”

Alvin Gentry on Omer Asik, Mar 5, 2017. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Kevin McHale on Omer Asik
item.description:
Jonathan Feigen:McHale on Asik's unhappiness w role before deadline:

“His job is to play. I assume his check is coming on the 1st and 15th of every month.”

Kevin McHale on Omer Asik, Feb 19, 2014. Source: Twitter @Jonathan_Feigen.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Omer Asik
item.description:
Andrew Perna:Stevens on Asik rumors:

“I haven't talked to Danny today. Last time I talked to him he didn't have anything.”

Brad Stevens on Omer Asik, Dec 18, 2013. Source: Twitter @Andrew_Perna.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Omer Asik, Dwight Howard
item.description:
Rockets general manager Daryl Morey said Sunday.

“It’s not done, but we have mutual interest to get it done, and we’ve had some early discussions. “We want him to work with Dwight and Omer (Asik), and he wants to do that.”

Daryl Morey on Omer Asik, Dwight Howard, Jul 15, 2013. Source: Houston Chronicle.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Omer Asik
item.description:
Mark Berman:Rockets GM Daryl Morey:

“When we didn't have Omer (Asik) out there last year (on defense) we sucked. We were terrible. I'm just being frank.”

Daryl Morey on Omer Asik, Jul 13, 2013. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Omer Asik
item.description:
Royce Young:Brooks on sticking with Hack-a-Asik:

“If we hit maybe one more shot, we would've gotten out of it.”

Scott Brooks on Omer Asik, May 2, 2013. Source: Twitter @dailythunder.

item.title: Joakim Noah on Omer Asik
item.description:
KC Johnson:Noah on Asik:

“I wish him nothing but the best. But I hope he plays like sh** tomorrow.”

Joakim Noah on Omer Asik, Dec 24, 2012. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Kelvin Sampson on Omer Asik
item.description:
Rockets coachKelvin Sampson on Omer Asik's offense:

“I saw flashes of no offense when he came in. Actually, his offense was offensive.”

Kelvin Sampson on Omer Asik, Nov 28, 2012. Source: Twitter @franblinebury.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Omer Asik
item.description:
Is he going to have to be more selective about the shots that he attacks?:Daryl Morey:

“He actually hasn’t been a super high-foul-rate guy even in Chicago, and in Chicago they were asking him to foul out a bit. [Wednesday] he fouled out and that will be something that, given, I agree with you, our defense does struggle with him off the floor.… Our half-court D has been the best in the league when Asik’s been on the floor so far this preseason. … I’m not actually too concerned about his foul rate. He’s very smart. He’s a very smart defender; he doesn’t gamble defensively.”

Daryl Morey on Omer Asik, Oct 22, 2012. Source: Sports Radio Interviews.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Omer Asik, Jeremy Lin
item.description:
Daryl Morey:

“I think our goal for this year ... is we fight for a playoff spot, even though it's one of the most challenging years to do that. The West is strong and if we were to make the playoffs, it means a lot of good things will have happened. Namely Jeremy Lin, Omer Asik or somebody else emerges to become an All-Star.”

Daryl Morey on Omer Asik, Jeremy Lin, Aug 29, 2012. Source: NBA.com.
